page_note: No cosmological substrate present. Page is an editorial extension of the five-fold enumeration pattern applied to Manichaean ecclesial concerns: why hearts/foreknowledge are not granted to all the elect. The enumeration structure (First/Second/Third/Fourth/Fifth) is formally substratic but is being used here to reason about church social dynamics — elect, faithful, apostles, foreknowers. Frame at i=3-5 ('Then said the Apostle... Be it known to you'). Heavy damage (66.7%) limits some judgments. The negative editorial fatigue score reflects the apostolic-dialogue formula loading the opening segments.
